maddeler.e:
تباهيت (form VI)
# تَبَاهَيْتُ (tabāhaytu) /ta.baː.haj.tu/: first-person singular past active of تَبَاهَى (tabāhā)
# تَبَاهَيْتَ (tabāhayta) /ta.baː.haj.ta/: second-person masculine singular past active of تَبَاهَى (tabāhā)
# تَبَاهَيْتِ (tabāhayti) /ta.baː.haj.ti/: second-person feminine singular past active of تَبَاهَى (tabāhā)
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
